resources.string: Allows Jarvis to open Android Quick Settings and press only allow-listed system tiles such as Wi-Fi, mobile data, hotspot, flight mode, Eye Comfort, and Do Not Disturb. It does not read messages or type inside apps.

Allows Jarvis to read the current accessibility screen only when you explicitly ask, and to complete confirmed Gmail or WhatsApp actions. Screen content is not stored, and messages are never sent without a separate confirmation command.
Listening locally for “Wake up Jarvis”. Tap to return to Jarvis.
